Type.evidence_source: In recognition of the multifaceted nature of the suicidal process, a qualitative grounded theory approach (Glaser, 1978, 1992) was chosen for this study. By examining data inductively, grounded theory aims to both describe and explain subject areas that may be difficult to access using quantitative research methods.

Area.evidence_source: This research method was chosen for this study because of the lack of knowledge about the emotional experiences of suicidal youth and limited understanding of the effect of emotions on suicidal behavior. The utilization of this method was consistent with the research objective that was to understand the emotional experiences of suicidal adolescents based on their subjective framework as they went through the suicidal state.
